scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Caramels?
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
你猎杀够50只刺猬虫了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
嗯，你好像还没猎杀够50只...

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Remember, I need help hunting Caramels so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀刺猬虫，去杀够50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Please kill 50 Caramels.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
请猎杀50只刺猬虫。

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
真厉害，这么快就完成了！

I can't, no more and I mean it.
Look at me I am serious I can't kill any more of these things.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
不行了，真的，一只也打不动了。
看着我，我没开玩笑，实在杀不动这些家伙了。

scripts.text: What things?
scripts.translation: 什么家伙

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
You know what, here is an idea.
You can gather them and I can give you a reward for your efforts!
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
对了，我有个主意。
你替我收集，我给你报酬，怎么样？

scripts.text: Gather Items
scripts.translation: 收集物品

scripts.text: Hunt Caramels
scripts.translation: 猎杀刺猬虫

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Ok, so I need 25 Porcupine
Quill's.
Please tell me you have some or can
help me
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
我需要25个刺猬尖刺。
拜托，告诉我你手头有，或者能帮我弄到吧。

scripts.text: I have Porcupine Quills
scripts.translation: 我有刺猬尖刺

scripts.text: Well I don't think I can help.
scripts.translation: 我想我帮不了你

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Great, you have enough!
Just like I promised a little reward.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
太好了，数量够了！
说到做到，这是给你的一点奖励。

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Where are the Porcupine Quills?
You think I wouldn't notice?
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
刺猬尖刺呢？
你以为我看不出来吗？

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
I need ^00CE0025 Porcupine Quills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
我需要^00CE0025个刺猬尖刺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Caramels.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
好，那就帮我猎杀些刺猬虫吧。
你打算猎杀多少只？

scripts.text: 50 Caramels
scripts.translation: 50只刺猬虫

scripts.text: 100 Caramels
scripts.translation: 100只刺猬虫

scripts.text: 150 Caramels
scripts.translation: 150只刺猬虫

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Hello, my name is Yullo.
Now wait a minute, are you not a little too high of level for this?
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
你好，我叫尤洛。
等等，你的等级是不是太高了，不适合做这任务？

scripts.text:
[Yullo]
Hmm, this maybe a little much of a request for you.
Come back when you are taller and stronger.
scripts.translation:
[尤洛]
嗯，这任务对你来说恐怕太勉强了。
等你长高些、强壮些再来吧。
